fix: Open the printer cover, load a new 80mm thermal roll with paper feeding from the bottom, close the cover until it clicks.
Open the cover, remove the jammed paper, wipe the platen roller, reload the paper and run a test print from the service menu.
Power off the printer for 10 minutes, check that the vents are not blocked, and replace the print head if the error repeats.
Reseat the reader cable, restart the POS application, and replace the reader if it is still not detected.
Clean the chip contacts with a lint-free swab and retry. Use the contactless fallback if allowed by policy.
Check the antenna cable, reboot the terminal and update the reader firmware.
Check the cable and the switch port link light, ping the gateway, then restart the network service. See the network connectivity runbook.
Verify the payment gateway is reachable, check the firewall rule for the payment port and retry. Escalate if the host status page shows an outage.
Renew the terminal certificate from the key management console and restart the payment service.
Check the RJ12 drawer cable at the printer, verify the drawer-kick setting, and use the manual key release for the customer meanwhile.
Reconnect the USB cable, scan the factory reset barcode from the scanner guide, and replace the scanner if unresponsive.
Open the service menu and run the touchscreen calibration utility.
Check the display cable and the resolution setting, then restart the application.
Clear logs and temporary files from the maintenance menu. Escalate if free space stays below 5 percent.
Collect the logs, restart the device, and reinstall the application package if the crash repeats.
Collect the diagnostics bundle and escalate to level 2 support.
Follow the cash dispenser jam runbook: take the ATM out of service, open the safe with two-person control, clear the note path and run a dispense test.
Reseat the cassette until it clicks, check the cassette ID switch and clean the cassette connector.
Schedule a replenishment visit. Refill is done with two-person control and the counters must be reset.
Empty the reject bin, log the rejected notes and reset the reject counter.
Remove the card with the retrieval tool, inspect the shutter for debris and run the card reader test.
Take the ATM out of service immediately, photograph the fascia and escalate to the security team. Do not touch anything else.
Replace the paper roll in the receipt module and run a test print.
Check the journal paper and ribbon, then restart the journal module from the service menu.
Do not reboot repeatedly. Reload the keys using the secure key loading procedure and escalate to the key custodian.
Check the PIN pad cable and run the keypad self test. Replace the PIN pad if the test fails.
Check the network link and router, ping the host, and restart the communication service. See the network connectivity runbook.
Check the host status and the terminal ID configuration. Escalate to the processing team if the host is healthy.
Verify the front door and safe door are closed and the door sensors are clean. Reset the alarm from the supervisor menu.
Check for movement or tampering on site, then reset the sensor from the supervisor menu.
Schedule a maintenance window and apply the update with the standard patch procedure.
Capture the diagnostics logs and escalate to level 2 support.
Reseat the USB cable at the reader and restart the kiosk application. See the kiosk card reader runbook.
Clean the reader slot with a cleaning card, then run the reader self test.
Empty the card capture bin and reset the counter from the service menu.
Load a new paper roll, making sure the paper is fed through the guide, and run a test print.
Power off, remove the jammed paper, check the cutter blade for debris and test the cutter.
Clean the screen, restart the display service and recalibrate the touch panel from the service menu.
Check the display power and video cable, then reseat the cable and reboot the kiosk.
Check the cable and the Wi-Fi or LAN link, then restart the network service. See the network connectivity runbook.
Ping the back-end service address, check the firewall and DNS, and escalate if the service is down.
Close the cabinet door and check the door sensor. Reset the alarm from the service menu.
Check the cabinet fan and vents, clean the dust filter and make sure the kiosk is not in direct sunlight.
Open the acceptor, clear the note path, clean the sensors and run the acceptor test.
Empty the stacker with two-person control and reset the counters.
Restart the kiosk application from the service menu and check the session timeout setting.
Retry the update, verify disk space, and roll back to the previous package if it fails again.
Collect diagnostics and escalate to level 2 support.
